title: 第23章 找麒麟没听错吧第24章 被神吓了一大跳
slug: 别人听劝仿明星你开局扮神明
content_zh:
烟海市气象局。
因为这场突如其来的冰雹，办公室的电话已经被打爆。
毫无疑问，正是诸多市民的举报电话，以及上级部门的严厉批评。
而气象局的负责人对这场毫无征兆的冰雹，也是满脑子的问号。
接着，就听电话那头传来市领导的斥责声：
“这次冰雹天气，你们这么大个气象局竟然没有发布任何预警！”
“我不管是因为什么，今后要是再发生这样的事，你们知道后果！”
“是是……”
气象局的负责人擦着额角的汗，连声答应道：“领导，我们保证没有下次了！
喂？……领导？”
听着电话那头传来的忙音，气象局的负责人长吐了一口气。
“真是奇了怪了……”
“怎么就会突然下起冰雹来呢？”
负责人仍是疑惑的念叨着。
旋即，负责人在一片忙碌的办公室里，朝下属们开口道：
“赶紧的，把烟海市的气象专家请过来，召开一个座谈会！”
“把情况调查清楚，今后像这种情况绝不允许再发生！”
……
烟海市的这场冰雹来得快，去得也快。
在维持了一段时间的凉爽后，天气又再度炎热起来。

烟海大学的军训仍在正常进行着，也好在快要接近尾声。
在准备迎接新生军训汇演的前夕，新生们难得的享受着两天假期。
新生宿舍里，林楠三人刚刚结束一天的军训。
“呼，总算是能喘口气了。”
姜涛坐在椅子上，翻看着手机道：
“哥几个，趁着这两天休息，打算去哪儿放松一下？”
“打住，哪儿我都不去……”
王成宇已然像死猪一般，累趴在了床上。
听到姜涛的声音连头也舍不得抬一下，嘴里们嘟囔道：
“这连着军训快两周，我累的都快瘦脱相了。”
“好不容易能休息两天，只想待在宿舍里躺尸。”
“害，至于嘛胖子。”
姜涛划着手机，朝王成宇撺掇道：
“我看咱们班群里有好多女生说要熟悉环境的，都想去学校周围转悠转悠。”
“这可是难得的机会，不打算趁机接触一下？”
王成宇闻言，头只是稍微抬了一下，接着又趴在枕头上道：
content_en:
Yanhai Meteorological Bureau.
Because of this sudden hailstorm, the phone numbers in the office have been ringing off the hook.
There is no doubt that it was the numerous calls from citizens and severe criticism from higher authorities.
The person in charge of the Meteorological Bureau was also full of questions about this hailstorm without warning.
Then, I heard the city leader’s reprimand coming from the other end of the phone:
"This hailstorm, your big weather bureau didn't issue any warning!"
"I don't care what the reason is, if something like this happens again in the future, you know the consequences!"
"Yes yes..."
The person in charge of the Meteorological Bureau wiped the sweat from his forehead and promised repeatedly: "Leader, we promise there will be no next time!
Hello? ...leader? "
Listening to the busy signal from the other end of the phone, the person in charge of the Meteorological Bureau took a long breath.
"It's really weird..."
"Why did it suddenly hail?"
The person in charge was still mumbling doubtfully.
Immediately, the person in charge spoke to his subordinates in a busy office:
"Hurry up and invite the meteorological experts from Yanhai City to hold a symposium!"
“Investigate the situation clearly and we will never allow situations like this to happen again in the future!”
…
The hail in Yanhai City came and went quickly.
After staying cool for a while, the weather became hot again.
The military training at Yanhai University is still going on normally, and fortunately it is coming to an end.
On the eve of preparing for the military training parade for freshmen, the freshmen enjoyed a rare two-day holiday.
In the freshman dormitory, Lin Nan and the three of them had just finished a day of military training.
"Phew, I can finally breathe."
Jiang Tao sat on a chair, flipped through his phone and said:
"Brothers, taking advantage of these two days of rest, where do you plan to go to relax?"
"Stop it, I'm not going anywhere..."
Wang Chengyu was as tired as a dead pig and lay on the bed.
Hearing Jiang Tao's voice, they were reluctant to even raise their heads and muttered:
"It's been almost two weeks of military training, and I'm so tired that I'm almost losing weight."
"I finally got two days of rest. I just want to stay in the dormitory and lie down."
"Harmful, as for the fat man."
Jiang Tao used his mobile phone and said to Wang Chengyu:
"I see that many girls in our class want to get familiar with the environment and want to hang out around the school."
"This is a rare opportunity, don't you plan to take the opportunity to get in touch?"
When Wang Chengyu heard this, he only raised his head slightly, then lay on the pillow again and said:
